answer: Because the timing is entered against the yarrow challenge, the nectar audit can replay the hollow history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 90 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
